```php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Concerns\HasUuids;

class Relation extends Model
{
    use HasFactory, HasUuids, SoftDeletes;

    protected $table = 'relations';
    protected $primaryKey = 'id'; // UUID via HasUuids
    public $incrementing = false;
    protected $keyType = 'string';

    protected $fillable = [
        'user_id', // Assuming a user model exists and we're using it as the relation's target
        'title',
        'description',
        'tags',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'id' => 'string',
        'title' => 'string',
        'description' => 'text',
        'tags' => 'array', // Assuming tags are stored as a comma-separated string in the database
    ];

    protected $hidden = [];

    // RELATIONSHIPS: define belongsTo for related models
    public function user(): \Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class);
    }
}
```
